instruction: Deduplicate in/contacts.csv (name,email,phone). Two rows are the same person when their lowercased email matches, or, when email is empty, their lowercased name matches. Write out/contacts.json: an array in first-seen order of {"name": first-seen name, "email": lowercased email, "phones": non-empty distinct phones in order seen}.
note: All paths are relative to the workspace root.
